title: Registration — HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The page says 2027 registration will open soon and gives no 2027 race dates.
Registration is non-refundable and non-transferable, with a one-time for-any-reason deferral to next year's event honoured until 7 September 2027.

Online registration closes on Sunday 3 October 2027 at 23:59 PT or when races sell out; there is no waiting list and no race-day registration, though on-site expo registration is available for open distances.
The minimum age is 18 for the 100M, 100K and 50K, 16 for the 21K and 12 for the 10K.

As a UTMB World Series Major, the event grants 60 automatic Finals places per Major — the top 10 women and men in the 100M, 100K and 50K — and all finishers collect double Running Stones; the Finals lottery needs at least one stone and a valid UTMB Index.
The event is a dual qualifier: a 2026 100M finish under 36 hours or a 100K finish under 18 hours earns a 2027 Western States qualifier.
The distance-change deadline is written as Thursday 3 September 2026 on this 2027 page.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接抓取并读取 2027 报名页。
